description: This file defines the ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter class, responsible for managing approval prompts related to execution requests in a macOS application. It handles incoming approval requests via a gateway connection, determines whether to prompt the user based on security policies and context, and resolves decisions accordingly.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter
classes.description: A singleton class that manages approval prompts for execution requests, including handling incoming requests, making decisions, and prompting the user when necessary.

classes.name: GatewayApprovalRequest
classes.description: A codable struct representing an approval request received through the gateway.

classes.name: PresentationDecision
classes.description: A structure encapsulating decision parameters about whether a prompt should be shown and whether it can be presented.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the asynchronous task to listen for approval requests.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the ongoing approval request listening task.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Internal method that subscribes to the approval request stream and processes incoming events.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles each approval request push, decoding it and deciding to prompt or auto-approve based on policies.

methods.name: shouldAsk
methods.description: Determines if the user should be prompted based on security and ask policy.

methods.name: shouldPresent
methods.description: Decides whether the prompt can be shown based on session context and input activity.

methods.name: fallbackDecision
methods.description: Provides a fallback decision when prompting is not possible, using allowlist patterns and request details.

methods.name: fallbackResolution
methods.description: Resolves the command resolution for fallback authorization based on the request data.

methods.name: firstToken
methods.description: Extracts the first token (command or executable name) from a command string.

methods.name: lastInputSeconds
methods.description: Returns the seconds since the last user input to determine recent activity.
